title: eat shit and die 193
author: bpatrick
html: I’m all moved in to my new place. Classes start in just a few weeks. There’re comics to be made and, damn it, I’m going to make them. Here’s one for the haters. It’s got a little of everything everyone hates about akimbo, except an unenlightened attitude toward the sexes but that can be assumed.

comments.author: Eric
comments.html: On the contrary, this has everything I love about Akimbo except for drawings of cigarettes!

comments.author: ignorance
comments.html:
Mmmm, made me think that maybe everything the haters hate about Akimbo is actually what everyone else loves about it. May be the case as I loved this one too.

<3

comments.author: Page
comments.html: I agree with the other posters, ESAD is my favorite part of Akimbo. Cynical? Maybe. Truth? Absolutely. Any haters are trapped in their own fantasy worlds.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: This may have a sprinkle of truth in it, but I prefer to reflect on my miserable life with a more positive outlook. Still put a smile on my face tho.

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.html:
Screw the haters. Make the comics you damn well want to make. Most of us love what you come up with. 🙂

cheers,
Phil

comments.author: David
comments.html: Shouldn’t the others be busy keeping themselves down rather than attacking the hero?
